metadata.host: Apple M2 Max, 64 GiB, macOS 15.6.1 (24G90), native aarch64
metadata.method: Real host main/run_single/finalize_dispatch code with boundary timestamps and a Mach-O constructor; same existing fingerprint-matched release libraries, ordinary fat-LTO release flags; uninstrumented hosts rebuilt in the same module layout are separate controls. Both revisions pack identical source with matching compilers. Synthetic HOME/BAML_HOME, fixed native child, auto_check=false; no cloud endpoints or inherited credentials. All builds finished before timed interleaved fresh processes. Parent/child use macOS CLOCK_MONOTONIC; each trace partitions that sample from posix_spawn through counters and wait4. Source/entry-point instrumentation can perturb optimization and scheduling; means sum, independent medians/p95 do not. Executable/file caches warmed; no physical cross-platform or cold-cache claim.
metadata.rust_wrapper_note: The explicit-local-path --version reference is ~17.94 ms, consistent with prior version_local ~17.77 ms. The earlier ~5.30 ms Rust comparison was the installed-version path; these are different operations and must not be substituted.
